analysis: This failure occurs in the test teardown ('after each' hook) while removing a temp workspace directory on Windows, with the OS reporting the directory as still locked (EBUSY). This is a well-known Windows file-locking race condition (e.g., antivirus scanning or a lingering child process holding a handle) unrelated to actual test logic or PR changes. PR #19939 only modifies CI skip-pattern/test-trigger-map configuration and does not touch the VS Code extension or its E2E tests. This exact cause was already tracked from a prior run with a matching error pattern and stack frame.
